{{Quote|What is in the Sertar sector?''"<br />"''That's where Florrum is.''"<br />"''You've been there? What can we expect?''"<br />"''Pirates.|[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], referring to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]]|<ref name="Revival (episode)">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Sertar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its worlds were mostly poor, backwater [[Planet/Legends|planets]] on little-used [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
At some point, businessman [[Ussto Lingsnot]], known for restructuring forty-three [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] economies, managed to manipulate fourteen Sertar sector markets without generating even one [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] rebellion.<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

The [[Sertar Sector Mining Guild]] was named after the sector.<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
